# transfer

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:learningTransfer`](gmeow-learningTransfer.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/learningTransfer>
- **Category:** individual
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/learning`](../../slices/learning.md)
- **Box roles:** [ABox role](../boxes/abox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A learning event in which knowledge or skill acquired in one domain is applied to a new domain — analogical transfer. Bridges the inference slice: the source-to-target structure-mapping that warrants the transfer is an inference [`gmeow:Analogy`](../classes/gmeow-Analogy.md) (Gentner), so a transfer event routes to that relator for its mapping. The bridge is documented routing, not an axiom.
